listing.name: Super Mario Odyssey (nxport)
listing.summary: The nxport builder can create a Mac or iOS version of Super Mario Odyssey from your own extracted Switch files. The project reports good rendering and a possible save defect. The tested platform and game version are unconfirmed.

steps.title: Check your original game files
steps.instruction: Provide your own extracted ExeFS, RomFS and Logo. The project does not identify a confirmed game version, region or title ID for this profile.

steps.title: Follow the project’s setup
steps.instruction: Build nxport-builder from source, select Super Mario Odyssey and choose the Mac or iOS target to produce a local app or IPA. There is no release package. You handle subsequent rebuilds.

warnings: Back up any existing saves before testing this build. The project reports a possible problem with saving.

references.title: Version and platform notes
references.instruction: Windows and Linux players are unconfirmed.
